resources.string: Declutter your dashboard by archiving old lists and groups! Archived items become completely read-only to prevent accidental changes.
Access, sort, and search through all of your archived lists and groups safely separated from your active items via the new dashboard icon.
We\'ve bypassed the confirmation dialog when you are bulk-deleting 2 or fewer records for a much faster workflow.
To keep your past financial data securely intact, you can no longer accidentally cut or copy active records into archived lists.
Added a brand new tip card detailing exactly how to manage Archived items and when to use them.
